subject.title: Feature Request: Support simultaneous backups for multiple WhatsApp accounts

question: Should concurrent wacli-backed profiles be accepted as a Wacrawl core capability, with this issue consolidated into https://github.com/openclaw/wacrawl/issues/46 as the canonical specification?
rationale: The requested feature adds new long-lived profile, source-adapter, locking, and backup behavior; current account-binding work establishes isolation but does not determine whether Wacrawl should own multi-account orchestration.

options.title: Consolidate under the broader proposal
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/wacrawl/issues/46 as the single canonical design item and link this issue’s acceptance criteria into it before any implementation begins.

options.title: Split the source adapter
options.body: Track a narrowly scoped read-only wacli import API separately while deferring profile orchestration and historical-ref work.

options.title: Decline core orchestration
options.body: Keep Wacrawl focused on one archive at a time and direct multi-account coordination to external tooling if that better fits project scope.

recommendation.title: Consolidate under the broader proposal
recommendation.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/wacrawl/issues/46 as the single canonical design item and link this issue’s acceptance criteria into it before any implementation begins.

likelyOwner.reason: The current account-isolation and source-binding foundation on `main` originates from the merged work attributed to steipete.
